tools.name: listAgentMemoryFiles
tools.description: List the memory files stored for an agent.

tools.name: getAgentMemoryFile
tools.description: Get the contents of a single memory file for an agent.

tools.name: listPluginCatalog
tools.description: List plugins that can be referenced by name in a build's plugins array. Builds may also reference any public GitHub repository URL (https://github.com/owner/repo) as a plugin; those are not enumerated here.

tools.name: createSchedule
tools.description: Create a schedule for an agent. The schedule fires against the agent's live build. The authenticated user owns the schedule.

tools.name: updateSchedule
tools.description: Update fields on an existing schedule. Only supplied fields are changed; omitted fields retain their current values. Owners may update their own schedules; team superadmins may update any schedule on agents in the current team.

tools.name: deleteSchedule
tools.description: Delete a schedule. Owners may delete their own schedules; team superadmins may delete any schedule on agents in the current team.

tools.name: getTeam
tools.description: Get a team by ID. The caller must be scoped to the requested team.

tools.name: startNativeOAuth
tools.description: Start an OAuth-based connection with a native provider (Gmail, Google Sheets, Outlook, etc.). tools.name: authorizeMcpOAuth
tools.description: Start an OAuth-based connection with a remote MCP server using Dynamic Client Registration. Returns an authorization URL the user must open in a browser; once they grant consent, Duvo creates the matching connection and redirects the browser to the optional `returnUrl`.

tools.name: checkMcpOAuth
tools.description: Probe an MCP server URL to discover whether it supports OAuth Dynamic Client Registration. Returns the authorization endpoint and required scopes when supported. Useful as a precursor to `/v2/teams/:team_id/connections/oauth/mcp/start` or `/v2/teams/:team_id/connections`. Performs no writes.

tools.name: listPulseDashboards
tools.description: List your Duvo Pulse dashboards (live, agent-generated visualizations of your Duvo data). tools.name: createPulseDashboard
tools.description: Create a new Duvo Pulse dashboard from a natural-language prompt (e.g. 'open cases by queue this week') and dispatch the first generation turn. Generation is asynchronous — poll GET /artifacts/{artifactId} until status is completed. The dashboard is private to you unless you set visibility to 'team'

tools.name: getPulseDashboard
tools.description: Get a Duvo Pulse dashboard's metadata and generation status. When status is completed and html_code_present is true, fetch the rendered HTML from GET /artifacts/{artifactId}/render; the conversation is served by GET /artifacts/{artifactId}/messages.

tools.name: getPulseDashboardHtml
tools.description: Serve a Duvo Pulse dashboard's rendered HTML document (text/html, not JSON). 404 until the first generation turn has produced HTML.

tools.name: getPulseDashboardPdf
tools.description: Render a Duvo Pulse dashboard to a PDF document (application/pdf, not JSON). 404 until the first generation turn has produced HTML; 409 for an openui dashboard, whose substrate this exporter cannot render.

tools.name: exportPulseDashboardHtml
tools.description: Render a Duvo Pulse dashboard to a self-contained static HTML snapshot (text/html, data baked in). 404 until the first generation turn has produced HTML; 409 for an openui dashboard, whose substrate this exporter cannot render.

tools.name: updatePulseDashboard
tools.description: Update a Duvo Pulse dashboard's settings — rename it. Only the creator can update it.

tools.name: publishPulseDashboard
tools.description: Publish (share) a Duvo Pulse dashboard to your whole team or your whole organization, or revert it to private (creator only). When publishing, set permission to 'view' (teammates see the dashboard) or 'edit' (teammates can also iterate on it); organization-wide viewers outside the team always get vi

tools.name: deletePulseDashboard
tools.description: Delete a Duvo Pulse dashboard. Only the creator can delete it.

tools.name: duplicatePulseDashboard
tools.description: Duplicate a Duvo Pulse dashboard, producing an idle clone of the current rendered dashboard. The conversation history, shares, and connections are not copied.

tools.name: sendPulseDashboardMessage
tools.description: Send an instruction to iterate on a Duvo Pulse dashboard (e.g. 'make it a bar chart', 'filter to last 14 days'). The creator can always iterate; teammates can too when the Pulse is published to the team with edit access. The agent regenerates asynchronously — poll GET /artifacts/{artifactId} for sta

tools.name: createPulseDashboardAttachmentUploadUrl
tools.description: Issue a presigned upload URL for a file to attach to a Duvo Pulse dashboard message (e.g. an HTML dashboard to copy, or a screenshot to match). POST the file bytes to the returned upload_url as multipart form data under the field name 'file', then pass the returned attachment_id in the attachments a

tools.name: getPulseDashboardAttachmentDownloadUrl
tools.description: Mint a short-lived presigned URL to download or preview a file attached to a Duvo Pulse dashboard message. Returns 404 once the dashboard's sandbox has expired and the file is gone (about 12 hours).

tools.name: refreshPulseDashboard
tools.description: Trigger an on-demand data refresh of a Duvo Pulse dashboard. The dashboard regenerates its connection-sourced values in the background — poll GET /artifacts/{artifactId} for status.

tools.name: stopPulseDashboardMessage
tools.description: Stop an in-flight Duvo Pulse generation turn. Requires edit access to the dashboard. Flips the dashboard to 'interrupted' and keeps any streamed-so-far reply; stopping when nothing is generating is a successful no-op.

tools.name: listPulseDashboardConnections
tools.description: List the connections (data sources) attached to a Duvo Pulse dashboard (requires edit access).

tools.name: attachPulseDashboardConnection
tools.description: Attach one of your connections (data sources) to a Duvo Pulse dashboard so the agent can use its tools (requires edit access).

tools.name: detachPulseDashboardConnection
tools.description: Detach a connection (data source) from a Duvo Pulse dashboard (requires edit access).

tools.name: answerPulseDashboardQuestion
tools.description: Answer a pending question the Duvo Pulse agent asked and resume the paused run (creator or team editors). Use the toolCallId from the dashboard's message transcript.

tools.name: listPulseDashboardMessages
tools.description: List the chat transcript of a Duvo Pulse dashboard's live version (requires edit access). Returns the most recent page by default, oldest first within the page; pass `before` (a message id from a previous page) to walk back through older messages. Messages from other version branches are not include

tools.name: listPulseDashboardComments
tools.description: List the comment threads on a Duvo Pulse dashboard (requires view access). Each thread carries its author, the dashboard element it is pinned to, its replies oldest-first, and whether it has been marked complete.

tools.name: createPulseDashboardComment
tools.description: Start a comment thread on a Duvo Pulse dashboard (requires view access). Pass `element` — captured from the dashboard canvas — to pin the thread to one element; omit it for a comment on the dashboard as a whole.

tools.name: createPulseDashboardCommentReply
tools.description: Reply to a comment thread on a Duvo Pulse dashboard (requires view access). `commentId` must be a thread root; threads are one level deep. A thread already marked complete still accepts replies and stays complete.

tools.name: setPulseDashboardCommentResolution
tools.description: Mark a Duvo Pulse dashboard comment thread complete, or reopen it (requires view access). Pass the target state in `resolved`; the call is idempotent, and the response carries the thread with `resolved_at` and `resolved_by` set or cleared.

tools.name: deletePulseDashboardComment
tools.description: Delete a comment or reply on a Duvo Pulse dashboard. Allowed for the comment's author and for the dashboard's creator. Deleting a thread root keeps its replies, rendered under a deleted opening comment.

tools.name: listPulseDashboardVersions
tools.description: List the version history of a Duvo Pulse dashboard, newest first (requires edit access). Use the version id with the restore and version-render endpoints.

tools.name: getPulseDashboardVersionHtml
tools.description: Serve a specific version's rendered HTML document for a Duvo Pulse dashboard (text/html, requires edit access).

tools.name: restorePulseDashboardVersion
tools.description: Restore a previous version of a Duvo Pulse dashboard, making it live again (requires edit access). Non-destructive — it moves the head pointer to the chosen version.

tools.name: createSandbox
tools.description: Create a new sandbox for file uploads. The returned sandbox_id can be passed to POST /v2/teams/:team_id/runs to stage data for a run.

tools.name: createSandboxUploadUrl
tools.description: Get a presigned URL for uploading a file into a sandbox. Use for files larger than 10MB; smaller files can be uploaded directly via POST /v2/sandboxes/:sandbox_id/files.

tools.name: listSandboxFiles
tools.description: List files in a sandbox directory.

tools.name: uploadSandboxFile
tools.description: Upload a file directly to the sandbox. Maximum file size is 10MB. For larger files, use POST /v2/sandboxes/:sandbox_id/upload-urls.

tools.name: getRunEvaluation
tools.description: Get the latest evaluation analysis for a specific agent run (Run).

tools.name: getEvalScores
tools.description: Aggregate evaluation counts and flag distribution for an Assignment's Jobs since the given timestamp.

tools.name: getEvalRubrics
tools.description: List the evaluation rubrics a Run is scored against: the platform default rubrics plus the Agent-specific rubrics for a build. Defaults to the Agent's live build; pass build_id to target the revision a specific Run ran against.

tools.name: createEvalRubric
tools.description: Add one Agent-specific evaluation rubric to a build. A build may hold at most 5 custom rubrics; this fails with 409 once that ceiling is reached. Defaults to the Agent's live build; pass build_id to target a specific revision.

tools.name: replaceEvalRubrics
tools.description: Replace a build's entire Agent-specific evaluation rubric set in one call (at most 5 rubrics). Existing custom rubrics are removed and the supplied list becomes the new set; pass an empty array to clear them. Defaults to the Agent's live build; pass build_id to target a specific revision.

tools.name: updateEvalRubric
tools.description: Edit a single Agent-specific evaluation rubric's title and/or description. The edit produces a NEW rubric (with a new id and slug) so previously scored Runs stay attributed to the original criterion; the response contains the new rubric.

tools.name: deleteEvalRubric
tools.description: Remove a single Agent-specific evaluation rubric. Future Runs on the build are no longer scored against it.

tools.name: listAgentSchedules
tools.description: List all schedules configured for an agent. Returns the schedules you own on this agent.

tools.name: listAgentCaseTriggers
tools.description: List the case triggers configured for an agent. Each trigger automatically dispatches the agent to run cases added to a queue.

tools.name: previewAgentCaseTriggerConflicts
tools.description: Preview which other agents would conflict with this agent's case trigger if it pointed at the given queue. Does not modify the trigger.

tools.name: getAgentCaseTrigger
tools.description: Retrieve a single case trigger by id.

tools.name: createAgentCaseTrigger
tools.description: Create a case trigger for an agent. An agent may have at most one case trigger; this returns 409 if one already exists.

tools.name: updateAgentCaseTrigger
tools.description: Update fields on a case trigger. Only the trigger creator or a builder/admin can disable an enabled trigger or change its queue, and only a builder/admin can change queue concurrency.

tools.name: deleteAgentCaseTrigger
tools.description: Delete a case trigger. Only the trigger creator or a builder/admin can delete it.

tools.name: listAgentTriggers
tools.description: List the trigger definitions the authenticated user owns on an agent (Agent in the Duvo UI). Triggers start a Run automatically when an external event fires (e.g. an email arrives or a Linear issue is created).

tools.name: upsertAgentTrigger
tools.description: Create or update the authenticated user's trigger for an integration on an agent. An agent holds one trigger per integration for a

tools.name: deleteAgentTrigger
tools.description: Permanently delete one of your own event triggers on an agent. The agent stops starting Runs for that event and the trigger's filter config is lost. To keep the trigger but stop it firing, upsert it with `enabled: false` instead.

tools.name: listAgentTriggerTypes
tools.description: List the trigger types available for an agent, grouped by integration. Use the returned `integration_slug` and `trigger_type` values when creating a trigger.

tools.name: createAgentSlackTrigger
tools.description: Create a Slack channel trigger on an agent (Agent in the Duvo UI): the agent starts a Run whenever a matching message is posted in the channel. tools.name: listAgentSlackTriggers
tools.description: List the Slack channel triggers you own on an agent (Agent in the Duvo UI), oldest first. Each trigger's `filter_config` carries the watched `channelId`, `channelName`, Slack `workspaceId`, and `matchRule`. Capped at 100 triggers per agent.

tools.name: updateSlackTrigger
tools.description: Update a Slack channel trigger you own — repoint it at another channel, change which messages match, or pause and resume it with `enabled`. Only the supplied fields change. tools.name: listAgentSlackBoundWorkspaces
tools.description: List the Slack workspaces bound to an agent build that you can create channel triggers for. Creating a Slack channel trigger for any other workspace is rejected, so start here to pick a valid `slack_team_id` and `integration_instance_id`.

tools.name: deleteSlackTrigger
tools.description: Permanently delete a Slack channel trigger you own. The agent stops starting Runs for that channel. To keep the trigger but stop it firing, update it with `enabled: false` instead.

tools.description: Create a new revision for an existing agent.

tools.name: getRevision
tools.description: Get a revision by ID.

tools.name: listAgentRevisions
tools.description: List revisions for an agent.

tools.name: updateRevision
tools.description: Update a revision's configuration, name, description, or handover targets. Returns the updated revision.

tools.name: promoteRevision
tools.description: Promote a draft or historic revision to the live version. The live revision is the one used by triggers and new runs. Fails if the revision is already live, or if a draft revision still has an active builder run.

tools.name: duplicateAgent
tools.description: Duplicate an existing agent into a new agent named "Copy of <name>", carrying over its configuration. Use the include_* flags in the (optional) body to control what is copied; all default on except memory. Requires the Lead Builder team role or above.

tools.name: getAgent
tools.description: Get an agent by ID.

tools.name: updateAgent
tools.description: Update an agent's display name or delivery settings.

tools.name: deleteAgent
tools.description: Delete an agent and cascade-clean its schedules, case triggers, builder runs, and handover targets. Any active jobs are interrupted and their sandboxes paused.

tools.name: moveAgent
tools.description: Move an agent (and its connected workspace) to a different team. Pass dry_run=true to preview the closure without applying changes.

tools.name: getAutomation
tools.description: Get a single automation with its agent and queue counts, and the tab arrangement its detail view navigates by.

tools.name: updateAutomation
tools.description: Update an automation, e.g. rename it. Only the fields present in the body are changed.

tools.name: getAutomationTabs
tools.description: Get the automation detail view's tab arrangement, plus metadata for the Pulse dashboards pinned into it. Pinned dashboards are filtered to the ones the calling identity may see.

tools.name: deleteAutomation
tools.description: Soft-delete an automation. Its member agents and queues stop dispatching and disappear from listings, but their underlying rows and run history are preserved (not erased) so the automation can be restored.

tools.name: getAutomationCurrent
tools.description: Get what the automation is set up to do right now: its member agents with the builds that are live, its queues' routing, and the triggers and schedules firing for it. The revision-less counterpart of the revision detail — an automation without revisions is read here.

tools.name: getAutomationCurrentFlow
tools.description: Get the automation's flow graph as it stands right now: the agents and queues it currently wires together, plus the producer, consumer, and handover edges between them. The revision-less counterpart of the revision flow.

tools.name: listConfigFields
tools.description: Read an automation's module config fields (its Policy), grouped by section in catalog order, with each field's current value, default, and fill provenance.

tools.name: listRevisionIntegrations
tools.description: List integrations attached to an agent revision.

tools.name: attachRevisionIntegrations
tools.description: Attach one or more integrations to an agent revision. To pin specific connections after attachment, use pinRevisionIntegrationConnection. tools.name: removeRevisionIntegration
tools.description: Remove an integration from an agent revision. Removes the slot for everyone on the revision, including all per-user connection pins. Requires edit permission on the agent.

tools.name: listRevisionIntegrationConnections
tools.description: List the connections you have pinned to this build's integration slot. Multi-pin is supported: you can pin multiple connections to the same slot.

tools.name: pinRevisionIntegrationConnection
tools.description: Pin one of your connections (from GET /v2/teams/:team_id/connections) to this build's integration slot. Multi-pin is supported: a single user can pin multiple connections to the same slot.

tools.name: unpinRevisionIntegrationConnection
tools.description: Unpin one of your connections from this build's integration slot. The connection itself is not deleted; only the binding to this slot is removed.

tools.name: getRevisionCaseQueueSetup
tools.description: Check that this build's case-queue integration slots are wired up correctly. A slot with linked_queue_co

tools.name: listRevisionIntegrationQueues
tools.description: List the queues linked to this build's case-queue integration slot. Only meaningful for case-queue-producer and case-queue-consumer integrations.

tools.name: replaceRevisionIntegrationQueues
tools.description: Replace the set of queues linked to this build's case-queue integration slot. Send the full desired queue list — any queues not in the list will be unlinked. tools.name: listAgentSuggestions
tools.description: List an Agent's suggestions. status=pending is the inbox; status=history is consumed/dismissed/auto-cleared. Reads lazily auto-clear stale pending items.

tools.name: getAgentSuggestion
tools.description: Fetch a single suggestion. Poll this after a 202 from consume: an AOP apply in flight reports payload.apply.state (running/failed); once consumed, applied_revision_id carries the draft revision the change was staged onto.

tools.name: consumeAgentSuggestion
tools.description: Apply a suggestion: stage its change into the Agent's draft revision, then auto-clear any pending suggestions it makes moot.

tools.name: rejectAgentSuggestion
tools.description: Dismiss a pending suggestion.

tools.name: listSystemSkills
tools.description: List all system skills (skills available to all teams).

tools.name: deleteSkill
tools.description: Delete a skill for the current team.

tools.name: downloadSkill
tools.description: Download a custom skill as a ZIP archive. Only custom (team-owned) skills can be downloaded.

tools.name: listSkillFiles
tools.description: List all files in a skill.

tools.name: getSkillFileContent
tools.description: Get the content of a file in a skill.

tools.name: updateSkillFile
tools.description: Update the content of a file in a skill, overwriting the active revision in place — the previous content is not recoverable. tools.name: listSkillAssignments

tools.name: listSkillRevisions
tools.description: List a skill's version history. Each revision is a snapshot of the skill's files; at most one is active (live) at a time, plus at most one open draft.

tools.name: createSkillRevision
tools.description: Open a draft revision of a skill, copying its files from the active revision (or from `source_revision_id`). tools.name: listSkillRevisionFiles
tools.description: List the files in a skill revision, one page at a time. When `has_more` is true, pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` to fetch the next page.

tools.name: getSkillRevisionFileContent
tools.description: Get the content of a text file in a skill revision.

tools.name: updateSkillRevisionFile
tools.description: Write a text file into a skill revision. Writing into a draft leaves the active revision untouched until the draft is promoted; writing into the active revision changes what the skill runs immediately. Historic revisions are read-only: create a draft from one to edit it.

tools.name: updateSkillRevision
tools.description: Rename a skill revision or change its description. Works for drafts, the active revision, and historic revisions.

tools.name: deleteSkillRevision
tools.description: Delete a draft or historic skill revision and its files. The active revision can't be deleted — activate another revision first.

tools.name: getProfile
tools.description: Get the profile of the authenticated user (the owner of the API key).

tools.name: getLegacyClarityProcess
tools.description: Get a legacy v1 Clarity process with process metadata, generated analysis, automation guidance, generation progress, and captures. Use this for rows from listClarityProcesses where version=1; v2 rows should use getClarityProcess and snapshot detail tools.

tools.name: updateClarityProcess
tools.description: Update a Clarity process name, guidance, visibility, or completion status. Team Builders can edit names and guidance, only the creator or a team manager can change visibility, and completion requires a manager role.

tools.name: listClarityProcessMembers
tools.description: List users with accepted access to a clarity process

tools.name: removeClarityProcessMember
tools.description: Remove accepted access to a clarity process

tools.name: deleteClarityProcess
tools.description: Delete a Clarity process. The creator or a team admin can delete it unless capture analysis is still in progress.

tools.name: duplicateClarityProcess
tools.description: Duplicate a Clarity process with its analysis, captures, message history, and, for v2 processes, its live current map and automation proposal. Requires a team manager role.

tools.name: createClarityVideoUploadUrl
tools.description: Create a signed URL for uploading a video file directly to GCS

tools.name: completeClarityVideoUpload
tools.description: Complete a video capture after uploading to GCS via signed URL

tools.name: createClarityDocumentUploadUrl
tools.description: Create a signed URL for uploading a PDF, TXT, Markdown, BPMN, XLSX, or CSV document directly to GCS

tools.name: completeClarityDocumentUpload
tools.description: Complete a document capture after uploading to GCS via signed URL

tools.name: createClarityImageUploadUrl
tools.description: Create a signed URL for uploading a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image directly to GCS

tools.name: completeClarityImageUpload
tools.description: Complete an image capture after uploading it to GCS via a signed URL

tools.name: inviteClarityMeetingNotetaker
tools.description: Invite the in-meeting notetaker bot (Recall.ai) to a live meeting; the recording lands as a 'meeting' capture on the process

tools.name: deleteClarityCapture
tools.description: Delete a capture from a clarity process

tools.name: createClarityGuidance
tools.description: Create a new automation guidance message for a clarity process

tools.name: updateClarityGuidance
tools.description: Update the automation guidance message for a clarity process

tools.description: Enable or disable sharing for a clarity process

tools.description: Get the active interview invite link for a process.

tools.description: Delete the active interview invite link for a process.

tools.description: Get information about a clarity interview invite link (public).

tools.name: acceptClarityProcessJoin
tools.description: Accept a clarity interview invite link and gain process access.

tools.name: deleteClarityLandscapeNode
tools.description: Soft-delete a tree node and its descendants. Organization admins may delete any subtree; team managers may delete a childless process node owned by their team. The targeted node's linked clarity process and captures are deleted, while nested processes detach to the Unsorted bag.

tools.name: setClarityLandscapeNodePlacement
tools.description: Move a process landscape node (team manager or above for team processes; organization admin for areas)

tools.name: reorderClarityLandscapeAreas
tools.description: Reorder a sibling group of the organization's process landscape area folders left-to-right — the top-level areas by default, or the folder children of parentId (organization admin+). tools.name: assignClarityLandscapeNodeTeam
tools.description: Set the owning team of a process in the process landscape (organization admin+). On a proposed process this accepts the proposal and creates the real process for that team; on an existing process it moves the process, its captures and its brief to another team.

tools.name: createClarityProcessNode
tools.description: File an existing Clarity process into an area of the process landscape (team manager or organization admin+). Use this for a process that already exists but sits in Unsorted; use proposeClarityLandscapeProcess to create a brand-new one.

tools.name: proposeClarityLandscapeProcess
tools.description: Create a manual process in the organization's Process Landscape, either as an unassigned proposal or atomically assigned to an eligible team.

Filter with type, unread, severity or minSeverity (mutually exclusive), important, agentRunId, or processId; paginate with limit/cursor. Pass batchId to list only the live members of a notification batch, optionally ord

tools.name: getNotificationFeed
tools.description: List the notification feed for the authenticated user's current team, most recent activity first. Each item is either an individual notification or a notification batch (a per-agent group of job_issue/eval_issue/job_done/schedule_issue notifications). Filter with type, unread, and either severity (e

tools.name: getNotificationBatch
tools.description: Get a single notification batch by id for the authenticated user, with per-type live-member counts, unread count, and worst severity. Serves cold deep links and sidebar retention for batches the caller can no longer see in the feed. Counts every live member by default; the optional type/severity/min

tools.name: markNotificationBatchRead
tools.description: Mark every unread live member of a notification batch as read for the authenticated user. Pass `types` to narrow the mark-read to those member types, and `severity` (exact) or `minSeverity` (threshold, mutually exclusive with `severity`) to narrow it by urgency — e.g. the page's active filters; omit

tools.name: getUnreadNotificationCount
tools.description: Get the unread notification count for the authenticated user's current team. Each notification batch with unread members counts as 1, regardless of its member count. Requires the Notification Center feature; returns 404 when it is not enabled for the team.

tools.name: getNotificationCounts
tools.description: Per-type notification counts for the authenticated user's current team. Narrow with `unread`, `important`, and with either `severity` (counts only that exact severity) or `minSeverity` (counts that urgency and above) — the two are mutually exclusive and a request carrying both is rejected with 400.

tools.name: markAllNotificationsRead
tools.description: Mark all notifications as read for the authenticated user's current team. Returns the count of notifications that were updated. Requires the Notification Center feature; returns 404 when it is not enabled for the team.

tools.name: deleteReadNotifications
tools.description: Soft-delete all read notifications for the authenticated user's current team. Returns the count of notifications that were deleted. Destructive — only call on explicit user request. Requires the Notification Center feature; returns 404 when it is not enabled for the team.

tools.name: deleteAllNotifications
tools.description: Soft-delete all notifications for the authenticated user's current team, read or unread. Returns the count of notifications that were deleted. Destructive — only call on explicit user request, never bulk-delete unprompted. Requires the Notification Center feature; returns 404 when it is not enabled

tools.name: listTeamMembers
tools.description: List members of a team. The authenticated session or API key must be scoped to the requested team.

tools.name: updateTeamMemberRole
tools.description: Update an existing team member's role. Requires the Manager role or above; only an Owner may grant or remove the Owner role, and the last remaining Owner cannot be demoted. A member whose Owner role is inherited from the organization cannot be changed here.

tools.name: removeTeamMember
tools.description: Remove a member from a team. Removing another member requires the Superadmin role or above; any member may remove themselves (leaving the team). The last remaining Owner cannot be removed, and a member whose Owner role is inherited from the organization can only leave voluntarily.

tools.name: listTeamInvites
tools.description: List a team's pending invitations — everyone invited who has not yet accepted or declined. Pass `processId` to list the pending invitations for a single Clarity process instead.

tools.name: listCredentials
tools.description: List browser-login credentials visible to the caller for the current team — team-shared (user_id IS NULL) plus the caller's own personal logins. Optionally filter by `domain`. Passwords and OTP secrets are never returned; only metadata flags indicating whether they are set.

tools.name: createCredential
tools.description: Create a login. At least one of `password` or `otp_secret` must be provided. Personal by default; pass `shared: true` to create a team-shared login (requires lead builder role).

tools.name: getCredential
tools.description: Get a login by id. Returns the encrypted password/otp_secret blobs — only the owner or team members can access it.

tools.name: updateCredential
tools.description: Update a login by id. At least one of password or otp_secret must remain set after the update. Editing a team-shared login or toggling sharing requires lead builder role.

tools.name: deleteCredential
tools.description: Delete a login by id. Deleting a team-shared login requires lead builder role.

tools.name: listActiveClarityExports
tools.description: List active (queued or running) Clarity export jobs for the current user

tools.name: startClarityExport
tools.description: Start a Clarity → SAP Signavio export job

tools.name: listClarityFolders
tools.description: List the team's process folders with process and suggestion counts

tools.name: createClarityFolder
tools.description: Create a process folder

tools.name: updateClarityFolder
tools.description: Rename a process folder. Renaming a landscape-linked folder permanently stops landscape name-sync.

tools.name: deleteClarityFolder
tools.description: Delete a process folder. Contained processes fall back to Unfiled.

tools.name: reorderClarityFolders
tools.description: Reorder the team's process folders to match the given id order. The payload must name every folder exactly once.

tools.name: setupClarityFoldersFromLandscape
tools.description: Create one linked folder per landscape group node containing this team's processes. Idempotent: groups that already have a linked folder are skipped.

tools.name: moveClarityProcessesToFolder
tools.description: Move processes into a folder (or back to Unfiled)

tools.name: fileSuggestedClarityProcesses
tools.description: File every unfiled process the viewer can see into its suggested folder

tools.name: listClarityTeamInterviews
tools.description: List team-level Clarity interviews

tools.name: deleteClarityTeamInterview
tools.description: Delete a team-level Clarity interview

tools.name: createClarityTeamDocumentUploadUrl
tools.description: Create a signed URL for uploading a PDF, TXT, Markdown, or BPMN document as a team-level Clarity capture

tools.name: completeClarityTeamDocumentUpload
tools.description: Complete a team document capture after uploading to GCS; extracts text and stores it as a transcript so it feeds Process Landscape generation

tools.name: getClarityTeamSettings
tools.description: Get clarity team settings for financial calculations

tools.name: updateClarityTeamSettings
tools.description: Update clarity team settings for financial calculations

tools.name: getClarityPortfolioIntelligence
tools.description: Get portfolio intelligence for the current team

tools.name: generateClarityPortfolioIntelligence
tools.description: Generate portfolio intelligence from all completed clarity processes. Returns 202 Accepted immediately and processes in background.

tools.name: movePulseDashboard
tools.description: Move a Pulse dashboard from the team in the URL to another team, keeping only its latest revision (chat history and older revisions are deleted). The caller must be a Manager or above on both teams. Pass dryRun=true to preview which Connections reconnect vs drop without applying changes.
